info.title: Save Editor Paradise
info.author: Edu90K
info.description: Edit game saves right on your Switch
info.details:
Edit your game saves right on the console. No PC, no copying files back and forth: pick a game, a profile, and a slot, then change what you want.

- Built-in editors for Zelda (Breath of the Wild, Tears of the Kingdom, Age of Calamity), Pokemon (Scarlet/Violet, Sword/Shield, Legends: Arceus, Let's Go), Mario (Odyssey, Wonder, Mario Kart 8 Deluxe), Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze, Smash Bros. Ultimate and Super Kirby Clash
- Zelda: unbreakable weapons, a Shrine Tracker and a map of Hyrule with your progress
- Every change is listed before it's saved, with an automatic backup first
- Manual backups, back up all games at once, restore and undo
- Find a value: turn any number you see in a game into an editable field
- Edit from your phone or PC in a browser on the same Wi-Fi
- English and Portuguese (Brazil)

Close the game before editing its save. Use offline: edited saves can be a ban risk online.

AI use: Mostly AI-generated. AI also used for: icon/banner art.
